name: Access Request For Identity With Multiple Accounts Failed
description: Sent to the requester if their access request failed because the user they requested access for has multiple accounts on the source.
subject: Access request for '${requestItemName}' failed
body:
Access request failed

Dear ${recipientName},

Your access request for ${requestItemName} could not be completed.

Your access request has failed because the identity you requested access for has more than one account on the ${sourceName} source.

Please contact your administrator for assistance.

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
